def slugify(text):
    """Return a lowercase ASCII slug derived from text."""
    if not isinstance(text, str):
        raise TypeError("text must be a str")
    text = text.lower()
    # Replace any sequence of non-alnum characters with a single hyphen
    slug = _NOT_ALNUM.sub("-", text)
    # Remove leading/trailing hyphens
    slug = slug.strip("-")
    return slug

import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '.')
from slugkit.core import slugify
# Test cases from acceptance criteria
tests = [
    ('Hello--World', 'hello-world'),
    ('a -- b', 'a-b'),
    ('one , two ; three', 'one-two-three'),
    ('x___y', 'x-y'),
    ('end!', 'end'),
    ('  padded  ', 'padded'),
    ('--both--', 'both'),
    ('(parens)', 'parens'),
    ('', ''),
    ('!!!', ''),
    ('   ', ''),
    ('Hello World', 'hello-world'),
    ('already-a-slug', 'already-a-slug'),
    ('Python 3', 'python-3'),
    ('MiXeD CaSe 42', 'mixed-case-42'),
    ('caf\xe9 cr\xe8me', 'caf-cr-me'),
    ('\u65e5\u672c\u8a9e', ''),
]
all_pass = True
for inp, expected in tests:
    out = slugify(inp)
    if out != expected:
        print(f'FAIL: slugify({repr(inp)}) = {repr(out)} expected {repr(expected)}')
        all_pass = False
if all_pass:
    print('All acceptance tests passed.')
# Test error cases
for bad_input in [None, 3, 2.5, ['a'], b'bytes']:
    try:
        slugify(bad_input)
        print(f'FAIL: slugify({repr(bad_input)}) did not raise TypeError')
        all_pass = False
    except TypeError:
        pass
if all_pass:
    print('All error tests passed.')
